originalArrow: (x, y) => { if (!L || !L.buriedcity || !tileSpr) return; for (let yy = y - 1; yy <= y + 1; yy++) for (let xx = x - 1; xx <= x + 1; xx++) { if (xx < 0 || yy < 0 || xx >= LW || yy >= LH) continue; const i = yy * LW + xx, t = L.grid[i]; if (t === T.AIR) { tileSpr[i] = null; continue; } if (t === T.SOLID || t === T.ONEWAY || t === T.SPIKE || t === T.SOFT) tileSpr[i] = BCT.bcTile(t, xx, yy, tileAt, T, L) || tileSpr[i]; else if (isSlope(t)) { tileSpr[i] = null; cvTile(xx, yy, t); } } }
